# crosswork_users (Resource)

This resource can manage a user in the local authentication store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_users" "example" {
  username            = "cwtest-gen-user"
  password_wo         = "CwtestPass123!"
  password_wo_version = 1
  policy_id           = "admin"
  first_name          = "Test"
  last_name           = "User"
  device_access_groups = [
    {
      uuid        = "b84e1a37-ef0d-4b79-984c-b162249d2e23"
      domain_name = "ALL-ACCESS"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_access_groups` (Attributes List) List of device access groups of the user (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_access_groups))
- `first_name` (String) First name
- `last_name` (String) Last name
- `policy_id` (String) Role of the user
- `username` (String) Username, 2 to 50 characters (letters, numbers and . - _ @)

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password, 8 to 72 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and one of @!$%*?&
  - **Required**: exactly one of `password` and `password_wo` must be set.
  - This attribute stores the secret in Terraform state. Prefer `password_wo` together with `password_wo_version`, which keeps it out of state.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password, 8 to 72 characters with upper and lower case letters, a number and one of @!$%*?&
  - **Required**: exactly one of `password` and `password_wo` must be set.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `password_wo`. Increment this integer whenever the write-only value changes so Terraform sends the new secret. The value is stored in state; the secret is not.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--device_access_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device_access_groups`

Required:

- `domain_name` (String) Device access group name
- `uuid` (String) Device access group UUID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_users.example "<username>"
```
